main: Precise background extraction for an existing video game HUD sprite atlas. The FOUR input images are EDIT TARGETS, not inspiration. Each shows an illustrated icon on the left connected to a long gold outlined horizontal meter on its right. Extract ONLY the left illustrated icon from each image, preserving its EXACT drawing, colors, shape, orientation, details, and its own gold contour. REMOVE the entire horizontal meter and every horizontal gold line/stub left by that meter. Do not redesign, modernize, simplify, embellish, or add symbols. Preserve original Haven & Hearth hand-painted icon style perfectly. Output one genuinely transparent RGBA sprite sheet, 2 equal columns by 2 equal rows, with large transparent gutters, all icons at consistent visual scale and each centered in its own cell. Reading order: top row = red heart, curled blue stamina swirl; bottom row = yellow lightning bolt, orange-green intestine/stomach (mount). Each icon must be isolated, complete and not cut off. The lightning must retain its entire tip and lower zigzag. No bars, no frames around cells, no background, no labels or text. Do not draw new icons; cut out the supplied originals. Canvas 1024x1024 if possible.
